# harness rule for Codex (Starlark, experimental rules engine) — install to
# ~/.codex/rules/no-push.rules. Belt-and-braces with the sandbox network
# block: git push is forbidden even if network access is later enabled.
# Test: codex execpolicy check --rules no-push.rules -- git push origin main
prefix_rule(
    pattern = ["git", "push"],
    decision = "forbidden",
    justification = "harness autonomy profile: never push from the agent loop",
    match = ["git push", "git push origin main"],
)

prefix_rule(
    pattern = ["git", "remote"],
    decision = "forbidden",
    justification = "harness autonomy profile: remotes are human-managed",
    match = ["git remote add origin x", "git remote set-url origin x"],
)
